statement: CVE-2026-59310, the actively exploited VMware vCenter Server directory traversal vulnerability, is added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-08-14 and 2026-09-25.
resolution: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog lists CVE-2026-59310 with a dateAdded field between 2026-08-14 and 2026-09-25 inclusive.
failure_condition: CVE-2026-59310 does not appear in the CISA KEV catalog by the deadline, or appears with a dateAdded value outside 2026-08-14 to 2026-09-25.

statement: CVE-2026-62832, the LegacyHive Windows User Profile Service elevation of privilege vulnerability, is added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-08-14 and 2026-11-13.
resolution: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog lists CVE-2026-62832 with a dateAdded field between 2026-08-14 and 2026-11-13 inclusive.
failure_condition: CVE-2026-62832 does not appear in the CISA KEV catalog by the deadline, or appears with a dateAdded value outside 2026-08-14 to 2026-11-13.

statement: The 10-Year Treasury Constant Maturity Rate, FRED series DGS10, closes at or above 4.75 percent on at least one trading day between 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-25.
resolution: The FRED DGS10 series shows a closing value of 4.75 or higher for at least one date between 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-25.
failure_condition: DGS10 fails to close at or above 4.75 percent on every trading day between 2026-08-17 and 2026-09-25.

statement: The 100 percent ad valorem tariff tier on qualifying drones and drone components under the August 13, 2026 presidential proclamation is in active collection by U.S. Customs and Border Protection as of 2026-09-10.
resolution: A Federal Register notice, CBP CSMS message, or Customs Bulletin confirms active assessment of the 100 percent tariff tier on qualifying drone imports as of 2026-09-10.
failure_condition: CBP has not begun collecting the 100 percent tariff tier by 2026-09-10, or a federal court has stayed or enjoined its collection before that date.

statement: NATO or a Baltic national air force kinetically shoots down or intercepts a drone or unmanned aerial vehicle inside Estonian, Latvian, or Lithuanian airspace, distinct from the August 14, 2026 Balvi incident, between 2026-08-21 and 2026-10-15.
resolution: NATO, a Baltic Ministry of Defence, or two of Reuters, AP, and Bloomberg confirm a kinetic drone shoot-down in Baltic airspace within the window, distinct from the Aug 14 Balvi incident.
failure_condition: No kinetic shoot-down or destructive intercept of a drone occurs inside Estonian, Latvian, or Lithuanian airspace, distinct from the Aug 14 Balvi incident, between 2026-08-21 and 2026-10-15.

statement: The government of Russia publishes a decree ordering a new mandatory, non-contract mobilization wave of reservists, distinct from routine conscription and from the September 2022 partial mobilization, between 2026-08-21 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: The official Russian legal register, pravo.gov.ru, publishes a mobilization decree, corroborated by two of Reuters, AP, ISW, and Meduza, within the window.
failure_condition: Russia issues no new mandatory mobilization decree in its official legal register between 2026-08-21 and 2026-11-30.

statement: The Electoral Commission of Zambia publicly declares an official winner of the 2026 presidential election between 2026-08-14 and 2026-09-11.
resolution: The Electoral Commission of Zambia, or the Constitutional Court of Zambia, names a president-elect, corroborated by two of Reuters, AP, and ZNBC, by 2026-09-11.
failure_condition: The Electoral Commission of Zambia has not declared an official presidential winner by 2026-09-14, whether from continued suspension, legal challenge, or annulment proceedings.

statement: Jury selection begins in the New York State murder trial of Luigi Mangione before Justice Gregory Carro in Manhattan Supreme Court on or before 2026-09-22.
resolution: The Manhattan Supreme Court docket shows jury selection commenced in the state case against Mangione on or before 2026-09-22, confirmed by the docket or a wire service.
failure_condition: Jury selection has not begun by 2026-09-24, whether from adjournment, a double jeopardy motion, a global plea disposition, or any other order displacing the date.

statement: USGS catalogs at least one aftershock of magnitude 5.5 or greater within 100 km of the August 10, 2026 magnitude 7.4 Choco, Colombia earthquake, event us6000tjl2, between 2026-08-14 and 2026-09-13.
resolution: USGS ComCat lists an earthquake of magnitude 5.5 or greater with an epicenter within 100 km of 4.9031, -76.1885 and an origin time in the window.
failure_condition: No USGS-cataloged earthquake of magnitude 5.5 or greater occurs within 100 km of the mainshock epicenter between 2026-08-14 and 2026-09-13.

statement: At least one reactor unit at the Cernavoda nuclear power plant in Romania resumes grid-connected generation between 2026-08-14 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: Nuclearelectrica discloses, via a Bucharest Stock Exchange filing, or ENTSO-E Transparency Platform data shows nonzero generation for at least one Cernavoda unit between 2026-08-14 and 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: Both Cernavoda units remain offline with zero grid-connected generation through 2026-09-30 per Nuclearelectrica and ENTSO-E data.
